scope.summary: Route whiteboard import/export through the unified import/export surface (14.13), not a whiteboard-private format layer: boards export to raster (PNG), document (PDF), and tabular (CSV, e.g. stickies/table rows) via StudioExportRecipe; delimited data (CSV/spreadsheet rows) imports as stickies or table objects. Importers for other whiteboard tools' content are compatibility targets with unsupported-feature receipts; resulting objects are local Studio board objects; no external importer service is a runtime dependency.
acceptance_criteria: board I/O via unified export surface; PNG/PDF/CSV; CSV import as stickies/table; receipts on foreign import
proof_targets: board export PNG/PDF/CSV + CSV import runtime test
expected_tests: live: export a board to PNG + PDF + CSV via StudioExportRecipe
live: import CSV rows as stickies/table objects
test: unsupported-feature receipt on foreign-board import

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

risk_if_missed: Whiteboard forks a private format layer; import/export parity gap.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
